description:
A giant mystery box lands on Biscuit's porch - taller than the mailbox, bigger than any dream. Biscuit is CERTAIN it is his gift, and he will guard it, claim it, and out-cute anyone who disagrees... especially Luna, the tiny white kitten who sits on the box like she owns it. Then the box SCRITCHES from the inside, a purr rolls out, and one single whisker changes everything: the biggest surprise on Maple Street was never meant for Biscuit. What happens next turns one giant box into three thrones - and one grumpy morning into the warmest ending on the street.

A funny dog and cat surprise story about sharing, kindness and the best kind of teamwork - told in cinematic animation with a warm British storyteller voice. Perfect for dog lovers, cat lovers and everyone who enjoys funny animal stories with a happy ending.

MEET THE CHARACTERS
Biscuit - a cream French Bulldog puppy with a blue collar and a heart of gold
Luna - a tiny fluffy white kitten with big green eyes and royal standards
Max - the neighborhood Golden Retriever and chief moral-support officer
